title: Flying Pigs Over Dark City
description: A surreal apocalyptic cityscape at sunset with dark gothic towers reflected in a body of water. Several oversized pigs, some wearing a top hat, float and fly through the blood-red sky while a small boat with glowing lanterns drifts on the water below.
prompt: A dramatic surreal fantasy painting of a dark gothic city with towering spires and illuminated windows at sunset. Several giant pigs float through the blood-red sky, one wearing a top hat, while others fly or stand on the shore. A small ornate boat with glowing lanterns floats on dark reflective water in the foreground, under a fiery orange and crimson sky with dramatic clouds.
